Title: Reading comprehension
Subject: English
Duration: 20 minutes
Instructions: Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.

[PASSAGE]
The tide notebook
Every morning Nia walked to the harbour and drew a line in her notebook at the height of the water on the old steps.

After a month she noticed that the highest mark came later each day. She lent the notebook to her uncle, who used her marks to decide when his boat could cross the shallow inlet.
[QUESTIONS]
Q1. What did Nia record each morning?
A. The height of the water
B. The number of boats
C. The temperature of the harbour
ANS: A

Q2. Why did the notebook help her uncle?
A. It listed the boats already in the inlet.
B. It helped him choose a time when the water would be deep enough.
C. It showed him where to buy a boat.
ANS: B
[/PASSAGE]
